Moreover, the experience of fasting can help individuals develop resilience, discipline, and self-control, which can translate to other areas of life. It can also encourage people to be more mindful of their consumption habits, waste, and impact on the environment, leading to a greater sense of responsibility and stewardship. The fact that Ramadan is a recurring experience, happening every year, means that individuals have the opportunity to reflect on their values and priorities annually. In many ways, the experience of Ramadan can be seen as a catalyst for personal transformation, encouraging individuals to re-examine their values, priorities, and relationships.
